themes.name: Daybreak
themes.author: StoryLark
themes.description: StoryLark's own face — warm paper instead of stark white, a dawn-teal accent, a gold "birdsong" read-along highlight, and a literary reading serif. Ships as the default theme in every StoryLark build.
themes.install: Import as a package: run `npm run package-theme -- storylark` in a StoryLark checkout, then install it from the admin portal's Brand & themes card or `npm run import-theme`. Building your own from it instead? Copy brands/storylark to brands/<your-id> and retune theme.css.

themes.name: Loveletter
themes.author: Loveletter Press
themes.description: A romance library as kept correspondence: rose-grey laid paper, plum-black ink, and one sealing-wax carmine held back for accents. The read-along highlight is a faded ink violet — a second hand's annotation — so it never competes with the seal.
themes.install: Import as a package: run `npm run package-theme -- loveletter` in a StoryLark checkout, then install it from the admin portal's Brand & themes card or `npm run import-theme`. Building your own from it instead? Copy brands/loveletter to brands/<your-id> and retune theme.css.

themes.name: Nebula
themes.author: Long Archive Press
themes.description: A science-fiction archive, dark by default: plate-emulsion violet-grey, bone-white catalogue text, and a desaturated reflection-blue accent. The read-along highlight is H-alpha rose — the one saturated colour in the theme — so the spoken word reads as a real emission line, not decoration.
themes.install: Import as a package: run `npm run package-theme -- nebula` in a StoryLark checkout, then install it from the admin portal's Brand & themes card or `npm run import-theme`. Building your own from it instead? Copy brands/nebula to brands/<your-id> and retune theme.css.

themes.name: Weatherglass
themes.author: The Weatherglass Society
themes.description: A weather-and-almanac library built from pulp-grey stock, cold ink, and admiralty chart blue — with the one warm colour, storm-warning rust, held back for the read-along highlight alone.
themes.install: Import as a package: run `npm run package-theme -- weatherglass` in a StoryLark checkout, then install it from the admin portal's Brand & themes card or `npm run import-theme`. Building your own from it instead? Copy brands/weatherglass to brands/<your-id> and retune theme.css.

themes.name: Wireless
themes.author: Wireless Playhouse
themes.description: Vintage radio drama as a valve set in an unlit parlour: bakelite brown, dial-lamp amber, and dial-glass cream text, dark by default. The read-along highlight is studio ON AIR red.
themes.install: Import as a package: run `npm run package-theme -- wireless` in a StoryLark checkout, then install it from the admin portal's Brand & themes card or `npm run import-theme`. Building your own from it instead? Copy brands/wireless to brands/<your-id> and retune theme.css.

templates.name: Story Library
templates.author: StoryLark
templates.description: The default shape: a flat list of standalone stories, no collection level, bottom tab bar. What every StoryLark build presents until presentation.json says otherwise.
templates.install: Not an independently installable package yet — presentation.json ships as an optional file inside a theme package, or copy presentation/storylark/presentation.json into presentation/<your-id>/ by hand. See build-your-own-presentation.md.

templates.name: The Almanac
templates.author: The Weatherglass Society
templates.description: A flat shelf of entries sorted by timeframe by default, square covers, and a relabelled nav: Today · Almanac · Listening · Settings.
templates.install: Not an independently installable package yet — presentation.json ships as an optional file inside a theme package, or copy presentation/weatherglass/presentation.json into presentation/<your-id>/ by hand. See build-your-own-presentation.md.

templates.name: The Long Archive
templates.author: Long Archive Press
templates.description: A series shelf — missions grouping logs — with a side nav rail, grid covers, and read+listen as the default mode. Relabelled nav: Overview · Archive · Playback · Settings · Provenance.
templates.install: Not an independently installable package yet — presentation.json ships as an optional file inside a theme package, or copy presentation/nebula/presentation.json into presentation/<your-id>/ by hand. See build-your-own-presentation.md.

templates.name: The Correspondence
templates.author: Loveletter Press
templates.description: A flat, most-recent-first shelf of standalone letters with grid covers and portrait aspect. Relabelled nav: Letters · Aloud.
templates.install: Not an independently installable package yet — presentation.json ships as an optional file inside a theme package, or copy presentation/loveletter/presentation.json into presentation/<your-id>/ by hand. See build-your-own-presentation.md.

templates.name: The Evening Serial
templates.author: Wireless Playhouse
templates.description: A series shelf — serials grouping episodes — with listen as the default mode, no speed dial, and Now Playing promoted second in the nav: Tonight · On Air · Schedule · Settings · Station.
templates.install: Not an independently installable package yet — presentation.json ships as an optional file inside a theme package, or copy presentation/wireless/presentation.json into presentation/<your-id>/ by hand. See build-your-own-presentation.md.
